findings.title: Command Count Mismatch - Missing 6 Commands
findings.consequence: Users cannot view fine details individually, cannot submit appeals, and admins cannot manage fine status or view appeals. Core functionality missing.
findings.correction: Implement 6 missing commands: fine-detail, fine-appeal, fine-appeals, fine-appeal-detail, fine-status, and consider fine-roles alias

findings.title: Database Schema Incomplete - Missing Appeals & Status History
findings.evidence: Fine document missing: guildId, targetUserId, reporterUserId, details, evidence, status enum, statusHistory array, appeal object. Currently uses isPaid boolean instead of status enum.
findings.consequence: Fine status cannot be tracked properly, appeals cannot be stored, status change history lost, no audit trail, multi-server support broken
findings.correction: Restructure schema to include: guildId, status (PENDING/REJECTED/PROCESSED), statusHistory array with changedBy/changedAt/note, appeal object with userId/content/status/submittedAt. Add updateFineStatus(), submitAppeal(), getAppeals() functions. Update indexes for guildId and status.

findings.title: Payment Logic Conflicts with Specification
findings.evidence: processFinePayment() directly calls payFineWithTopup() Payroll API. Specification FINE_REPORTS.md line 27: 'Quản trị viên xử lý coins bên ngoài rồi cập nhật trạng thái biên bản', line 79: 'Việc chuyển trạng thái không tự động thực hiện', line 108: 'Cập nhật trạng thái không gọi API'. But user request message #5 says 'áp dụng api /totup'.
findings.consequence: System violates specification by auto-processing payments instead of letting admins handle manually. Ambiguity between spec and user request.
findings.correction: Clarify requirement: Either (A) Remove automatic API call, let admin manually handle payment then use /fine-status to mark PROCESSED, OR (B) Update specification to reflect auto-payment workflow. User request conflicts with specification document.
